description: Your ChatGPT history as a queryable local archive — verified-complete extraction, outlines, and search no other tool has.

tools.name: chat_prepare
tools.description: Conduit prepare — mints the short-lived (60s) conduit token required by the send call. Returns the new ConduitPrepare.

tools.name: chat_requirements
tools.description: Sentinel gate — returns requirements token, PoW seed/difficulty, turnstile requirement (token values are credential material). Optional: proof.

params.name: proof
params.description: Base64 fingerprint/proof payload (empty for the first mint)

tools.name: chat_send
tools.description: Send a message — SSE response with typed events; message_stream_complete is the semantic terminal; resume_conversation_token enables reconnection. EXPERIMENTAL: turnstile-gated; fails clearly without legitimately issued authorization. Required: action, messages, parent_message_id, model. Optional: conversation_id, timezone_offset_min, thinking_effort.

params.name: messages
params.description: Message array (id + author role user + content object with content_type text and parts list)

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: Conversation UUID — omit to start a new chat

params.name: parent_message_id
params.description: Parent node — current_node for a follow-up

tools.name: conversations_get
tools.description: Full conversation as the webapp consumes it — messages array plus Relay page_info; has_next_page can be false on truncated windows, verify against current_node. Required: conversation_id. Optional: num_turns, include_has_versions. Returns the Conversation.

params.name: num_turns
params.description: Turn-window limit (response may still claim has_next_page=false)

tools.name: conversations_get_tree
tools.description: Legacy compat read — singular endpoint returns the parent/children mapping tree (visible roles only; no hidden system/thoughts nodes). Required: conversation_id.

tools.name: conversations_list
tools.description: Chronological conversation list — offset/limit pagination; total is a min(realTotal, offset+limit+1) hint, walk pages until a short page. Optional: offset (default: 0), limit (default: 28), order (default: updated) (plus 2 more). Returns the ConversationList.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort key (updated accepted; created returns 500 — sort client-side)

tools.name: conversations_list_messages
tools.description: Message window with forward cursor — after=<message_id> returns everything after that id (cursor/limit/end_cursor params are ignored here). Required: conversation_id. Optional: after.

params.name: after
params.description: Return messages after this message id

tools.name: conversations_search
tools.description: Legacy search — query param is literally 'query' (not q); returns message-level hits with snippets. Required: query. Optional: offset, limit.

tools.name: conversations_stream_status
tools.description: Streaming state for an active send (404 when idle) — used by status/wait. Required: conversation_id. Returns the StreamStatus.

tools.name: global_search_global
tools.description: Federated message-content search across conversations and projects — strict body schema (extra fields 422); cursor pagination. Required: query. Optional: limit, cursor. Returns the new GlobalSearchResults.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response

tools.name: models_list
tools.description: Model picker inventory — slugs, reasoning types, thinking efforts, default badge. Optional: history_view_enabled. Returns the ModelsResponse.

tools.name: session_get
tools.description: Current session, account, and freshly minted access token (values are credential material — never logged). Returns the Session.

novel_features.name: Hydrated chronological inventory
novel_features.description: See every chat in chronological order with turn counts, time span, and freshness — not just titles.

novel_features.name: Verified-complete extraction
novel_features.description: Extract an entire conversation with a completeness proof against the live tree state.

novel_features.name: Long-thread outline
novel_features.description: Map a long thread into titled sections at each of your prompts, with timestamps and anchors.

novel_features.name: Section-sliced extraction
novel_features.description: Extract just part of a long conversation by section number or message anchors.

novel_features.name: Dual-mode search
novel_features.description: Search message content server-side by default, or offline over your synced archive.
